theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Highest combination of trend health among eligible, high-durability names: durability_bar 0.84, hurst 'trend', full breadth 1.0, not crowded (crowding_z 0.55). This is the strongest 'staying power' leg in the detector — the one validated as risk control. I lean with the established trend rather than chasing the faster-moving but low-durability Memory leader.
theses.dissent: Gold miners are reflexively tied to real yields and the USD; a risk-on AI-rally continuation could starve the precious-metals complex of flow while Memory/HBM keeps leading on narrative.

theses.subject: Silver Miners
theses.thesis: Same high-durability, full-breadth, trend-healthy metals profile as gold miners (durability 0.79, breadth 1.0), and the rotation challenger to the leader. Leaning here expresses the only leg with validated forward value — trend persistence in high-durability names — without chasing the low-breadth top name.
theses.dissent: Silver has a larger industrial-demand beta than gold; an abrupt global growth scare could hit silver miners harder than gold miners, and the rotation margin to Memory is wide (1.035).
